trechos: Patients will receive Doxil at the standard dose of 20 mg/m2 IV for the 1st cycle.
If no DLT occurs, then a double dose escalation of Doxil (dose levels 3, 5, 7 ) will be given to the same patient in the subsequent cycles until DLT occurs.
